video_title: Wemby's HISTORIC Performance! + Sixers BEST TEAM in the NBA?!?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers are the most consistent and dominant team in the East
quotes.excerpt: They've been the most consistent, they've shown to be the most dominant so far.
quotes.quote: They are the team to beat in the East right now. They've separated themselves from the pack in this early season so far. They've been the most consistent, they've shown to be the most dominant so far. You can't credit this group enough as far as how quickly they've come together, how quickly they've gained a chemistry. It looks like a group that has one goal in mind, which is competing for a championship at the end of the year. It was easy to pick this team apart early on trying to figure out where the ball would go, whose team it was, what pecking order each guy is in. None of that has been a conversation since the season started. This is a group that has one goal in mind, and that's towards the end of the year. The only thing holding this group back as of right now is health.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers have not given media any excuses for negative coverage
quotes.excerpt: They haven't given us any excuses to talk in any sort of negative light about this team.
quotes.quote: I don't think those conversations have happened yet because they are winning games. We haven't had as media to spark these conversations of who gets the ball at the end of the game. LeBron James looks old, their bench is thin. They haven't given us any excuses to talk in any sort of negative light about this team. They don't turn the ball over. They are first in the fewest amount of turnovers, I think at 11 or 12 a game. This team with that roster, I didn't think they'd be the number three defense in the NBA. They've all bought in, they're all playing their roles. We know offensively they have so much firepower, but we didn't think that we would know how quickly they would mesh.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Sixers are the perfect storm of talent and complementary pieces
quotes.excerpt: They put as many complementary pieces and players around him as they could.
quotes.quote: They deserve their respect. I thought last year the Sixers were in a pretty good spot to continue on and do what they were doing. Then you add Jaylen Brown and you add LeBron James to it. At first you think that might be a little too much, there might be some egos, there might be some issues. We don't know, let's see how it plays out. It's the perfect storm. Jaylen Brown has come to this team, he just said it, this Maxey crew, we are here as complementary pieces to him. I think that's the right mentality to have. It started as Joel and Embiid's group. They put as many complementary pieces and players around him as they could. You bring in Maxey as part of that. Maxey turns the corner and he turns into this star. He's healthy, he's the youngest guy. Let's play at his pace. That's probably going to benefit us the most if we play at Tyrese Maxey's pace.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Sixers' winning streak prevents negative media narratives
quotes.excerpt: As long as they keep handling business, that's not going to be a conversation because they're winning games.
quotes.quote: As long as they keep handling business, that's not going to be a conversation because they're winning games. That is the main goal, that is the objective. Yeah, that's fun, that's juicy to talk about who gets the ball at the end of the game, who are the All-Stars. Trust me, we're going to start talking about in a month when All-Star voting comes out, which three you're going to make All-Star, which two, who's going to start, who's going to snub. That's all just a distraction to this really good basketball team trying to win a championship. Joel and LeBron are obviously those two first questions that you're going to ask about their health throughout the season.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs, Rockets, Timberwolves, and Nuggets are top Western Conference teams
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Minnesota, if they survive and they can get back healthy, they're going to be another team.
quotes.quote: If you're asking me other teams that's going to be competitive in the West to come out on top, you got to show respect to the Houstons of the world. I feel like Minnesota, if they survive and they can get back healthy, they're going to be another team. I think those are going to be the four teams in the West that's going to keep tabs on each other, that's going to continue to put pressure on each other with the way that they're playing. But listen, if we want to get into this Wembanyama conversation, last night he was incredible.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's dominance on both ends of the floor is mesmerizing
quotes.excerpt: It's so crazy how you just watch him flat-footed just beat dudes shots up and alter the entire game.
quotes.quote: It's so crazy how you just watch him flat-footed just beat dudes shots up and alter the entire game defensively. It really is crazy. It reminds me of when I play with my son and his little friends in a Nerf hoop game and I'm just beating shit all over the place. It's weird. I don't know how we got here and I don't know how it continues to amaze me, but offensively and defensively, the way this guy just snatches rebounds, puts the ball behind his back, gets out in transition. After there was one possession where he blocked Cooper Flagg, he blocked PJ Washington, he blocked Daniel Gafford. He had three blocks in like 30 seconds. I was like, what the hell am I watching? It really was mesmerizing.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Right now, I would rank him top 20 in the NBA and I think that he can continue to rise in those rankings. I do think he is an All-NBA type player and that's going to come. The dude is 19 years old, he's extremely talented. His first basically the first games up until the last two, he's been unbelievable. He's kind of expanded his game. My only problem with Cooper Flagg is when the ball is not going through the basket and he's inefficient, you can see it weighs on him.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Don't do that. Don't do that.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: But like every other superstar in this league, and that's what I'm going to call him, a superstar, because whether he is today or tomorrow, he's going to be that, he has to have find ways to impact the game in other ways when he's four for 30 from the field in his last two games and a certain point of the game.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg is a 19-year-old superstar in the making
quotes.excerpt: We're talking about a kid that can't even buy a damn drink yet.
quotes.quote: I think that's completely unfair, man. We're talking about a kid that can't even buy a damn drink yet. Like, get a guy some time, man. Like, you're comparing a 19-year-old kid to 30-year-old guys in their prime. Like, no, I just want him to impact winning in other ways other than scoring and I don't see that. I think he will, though. I think he will. He's one of the more versatile defenders in this league. He's still learning. He's still learning. Like, he has to go through his process. He's learning how to be a winner. He's learning how to be a superstar. He's learning how to impact the game on nights he is having bad nights. That's a process that everybody that's came through this league had to go through. So, I don't think it's any different from him and I don't think that dims his light as a star.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's potential trade landing spots and team fit
quotes.excerpt: If Kyrie went to Miami, was that make them a contender right away?
quotes.quote: If Kyrie went to Miami, was that make them a contender right away? Or is it kind of a lateral move? Or is it kind of a lateral move for them? I don't think either of them are winning a championship. But what gives you a better chance? Probably Miami getting paired with Giannis. I was going to say the difference is one team is trying to compete, the other one isn't in that mode yet. So what gives you a better chance to be the team trying to compete? Like Dallas probably didn't go in the camp like championship or bust. You know what I'm saying?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's versatility and growth as a player
quotes.excerpt: I think it's beneficial for him to have somebody like a Kyrie Irving around.
quotes.quote: I'm in the middle of the road because we're talking about a young budding superstar in a Cooper Flagg. I think it's beneficial for him to have somebody like a Kyrie Irving around where he can get some game from. He can understand an NBA champion and all of those things. On the flip side of that coin, I would like to see Kyrie Irving go somewhere at this stage in his career where he's around veterans, where he's around a real group that's going to give him an opportunity to get back to the top of the mountain like he's been before. So, I'm in the middle of the road with what the Mavs could do with Kyrie Irving. But if you're asking me to pick one side or the other, let Kyrie go somewhere, say Miami. I've been seeing Miami floating around somewhere. Go somewhere where you can be appreciated.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving provides necessary scoring and playmaking for Dallas
quotes.excerpt: I want someone to kind of take some of that pressure off. I want someone to handle the ball.
quotes.quote: If I'm Cooper Flagg, I want Kyrie Irving in Dallas. I want someone to kind of take some of that pressure off. I want someone to handle the ball to not just allow double team after double team every time I get in the paint because you have one of the best scoring guards of all time on the floor at the same time as you. I personally, I think Cooper would want that and I think Kyrie Irving helps them win basketball games and keeps them more relevant and has them a better chance to win at the end of the day. So, I don't think it's a situation where Kyrie is stunning his growth by any means. I think this is Cooper Flagg's team. He is the franchise player. He is the guy going forward, but you need talent. Look how much talent these other teams that are contending for championships have, whether they have a superstar talented young guy or not. They still have the talent there to win basketball games.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves are a well-rounded team despite Anthony Edwards' injury
quotes.excerpt: I think Tim Connelly did an incredible job of putting a team around Anthony Edwards this off season.
quotes.quote: I think this is a situation that nobody was kind of expecting as far as Anthony Edwards going down early. But also it's shining a light on the rest of the talent that's on this group. I think Tim Connelly did an incredible job of putting a team around Anthony Edwards this off season. And I'm even going to go out on a limb, I'm going to say it now, I think Bones Hyland has a chance of being sixth man of the year. They have a lot of depth, they have a lot of guard play. They have some high impact guards that can change the game, coming off the bench, starting, it doesn't matter. You have Kyle Anderson, 21 points, Bones Hyland, 19 off the bench, Jaden McDaniels playing high level of basketball, Mike Conley running the show, so this is a well-rounded group. It's a lot of firepower within this team and with Anthony Edwards going down, I think it's going to shine a light on everybody else's talent until he's able to return. So, long as they keep everything afloat, I still I still believe this team has a great chance of coming out of the West. They're that good, they're that loaded and they're just they're missing their superstar right now and once he returns, I think things go right back to normal.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's rim protection is valuable despite offensive struggles
quotes.excerpt: It's unacceptable to be 10 plus years in the league and still not be able to catch the basketball.
quotes.quote: I mean it's unacceptable to be 10 plus years in the league and still not be able to catch the basketball. It's a bit frustrating to see but you know, I understand what they feel like he brings to the game and that's you know, the rim protection. You know, I'm sure I have to go get the calculator, put the numbers in to fully understand what he brings to the game. I got him right here, I got him right here for you if you need help. I know this is a numbers thing, so it's not based off the eye test. You got to go look at the numbers to understand. Well, I'm an eye test guy. I'm an eye test guy too, that's why I don't understand.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant is a top-five all-time scorer
quotes.excerpt: The number five scoring, yeah. People will not put it because here's the thing, 10 is not a lot.
quotes.quote: The number five scoring, yeah. People will not put it because here's the thing, 10 is not a lot. Just cut the radio off. Listen, just cut the radio off. You don't have to love Kevin Durant, but let's not be silly, bro. This is a top-10 player of all time. You don't have to like him. Y'all can bring up Twitter, y'all can bring up all of that when the ball go up, Kevin Durant is a top-10 player of all time. I don't care what you try to base your argument around. He's one of the best players that we've ever seen, period.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant is a top-10 player of all time
quotes.excerpt: He just passed Dirk Nowitzki in scoring. We didn't even talk about it.
quotes.quote: He just passed Dirk Nowitzki in scoring. We didn't even talk about it. That's one we just let slide. That's just normal because this dude is that good that it's not even like that crazy to even speak of. But he just passed one of the greatest scoring bigs of all time and we're just like talking about Philly. Like it's it's it's insane how talented and how good and how long this guy's career has been. If LeBron James wasn't in year 24, we'd be talking about the crazy longevity of him, then the clip that he's doing that and the All-Stars and the All-NBAs and year 19. Like this dude is insane and hoopers know, like you don't want to guard that dude. Like you you you don't want that smoke. Like he is insane. So yes, to answer your question, he is a top-10 player of all time.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's personality shouldn't impact his all-time ranking
quotes.excerpt: Only thing that could keep him out of the top 10 is the fact that people may not like his personality.
quotes.quote: Only thing that could keep him out of the top 10 is the fact that people may not like his personality, which has nothing to do with anything. Or the older dude, or the older dudes with the crazy resume. He's year 19, he's still averaging a dub plus. And let's be honest, Houston is playing great this year, but Kevin Durant hasn't even really put his foot on the gas. He's on cruise control right now. So absolutely a top-10 player all time. I can see him being second on the all-time scoring list as well by the end of his career. So, he's five now. I like it.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic remains one of the best players in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think Nikola Jokic is just as good at basketball this season as he was three seasons ago.
quotes.quote: I think Nikola Jokic is just as good at basketball this season as he was three seasons ago. That's that answer to the question. I don't think he's worse at basketball now than he was last year or two years ago. I just don't think their team's necessarily having the success right now early. I still think they're dangerous. I still think he's it's still him, SGA, and Wemby in the top three players in the NBA, no matter what their team's record say. So, I I agree to a standpoint of of of success and maybe you're on the decline, but no, like I think Jokic is just as good at basketball this season as he was three seasons ago.
